headline: SDP @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.30 at CHC 5.07, with a projected total of 9.37. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: SDP moved +0.01 runs while CHC moved +0.69, changing the projected margin by -0.68 runs. The projected total climbed +0.70, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +16.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: JP Sears has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 1 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rodolfo Durán, Pete Crow-Armstrong because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
